speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, don't make that noise. It's disrespectful. Sorry, Leslie. I guess I prefer my space stringy, not loopy.

speaker: Leslie
text: You agree with me, right? Loop quantum gravity is the future of physics. Well, I'm glad I found out the truth about you before this went any further.

speaker: Leonard
text: Truth? What truth? We're talking about untested hypothesis. It's no big deal.

speaker: Leslie
text: Oh, it isn't really? Tell me, Leonard, how will we raise the children?

speaker: Leonard
text: I guess we wait until they're old enough and let them choose their own theory.

speaker: Leslie
text: We can't let them choose. They're our new children.

speaker: Leslie
text: I'm sorry. I could have accepted our kids being genetically unable to eat ice cream or ever get a good view of a parade. But this? This is a deal breaker.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I should hope so. It was a snort of derision. Look on the bright side.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Only nine more months to Comic-Con.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Captain, I'm getting an unusual reading.

speaker: Leonard
text: Yeah, that's great. You guys want corn dogs?

speaker: Sheldon
text: That's a temporal anomaly. Corn dogs didn't come into existence until the first half of the 20th century.
